Other unsupported clips and summary-only sessions are inventoried, not claimed measured.
method.fixturePolicy: setup-mapping inputs are reconstructed with current setupParams; digest=0 is an authored placeholder, not an archived digest

firstIce: The owner's live Godot save (`ice-run-replay.json`, modified 2026-11-11 18:02, read in place and never modified). The 2026-11-11 hand-off describes First ice as a 75 s replay with 5 falls and a mean speed of 0.64 m/s; this file measures 75 s, 5 falls and 0.642 m/s, which matches on all three. The hand-off's 17:55 stamp is not stored in the file, so identity rests on those three numbers. It is solver /39 without the three later knobs (weightTransferMode, weightTransferTime, beatCrossoverHoldSuppress), so it runs through the explicit off-mode adapter, and every one of its 9000 archived digests matches with the param off.
ownerChoice: Recommendation: leave `boardsSnapInbound` off in every setup (Simulation, Explorer, Experimental, Dig Gate, Repertoire) for now. The inward snap does not unstick First ice: stuck time is 52.8 s off and 41.4 s on, its longest stuck interval 16.4 s off and 16.4 s on, and the digests diverge from tick 1250, so turning it on would also change how that recorded clip plays back (playback runs the same collision between ticks, game/main.ts:534). The only standing gap in the measured corpus is Katya Vell in the warm-up pilot, 97 ticks, 1.13 mm deep; with the snap on that falls to 10 ticks, all of them while fallen, at the same 1.13 mm, which comes from the fallen-skater policy the snap leaves alone. So the warm-up's 2 mm allowance cannot go back to 0 on this change alone; it could only if the owner also decides that a fallen skater is held by the boards. If you still want a zero standing gap, the narrowest place to turn it on is the warm-up pilot (game/warmup.ts), with the tolerance left at 2 mm; Godot's bridge/engine.mjs would need the param passed separately and was not touched. Authored: the 2 mm stuck proxy and every threshold in this document. Pending owner decision.
